text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the approval of a parking prohibition for Jutten Court. The proposed amendment will prohibit parking around the outer perimeter of the Jutten Court cul-de-sac island, complementing the existing parking prohibition around the outside of the court, and improve vehicle movements along the street.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times around the outer perimeter of cul-de-sac island on Jutten Court.
